$comment: Stratum B — the G4 projection config for api.qa over the fn-it substrate (property-template §2, 2026-08-23). Content, not code. Non-exclusive by design: apis.ax (B2A, cross-cutting) may project the same substrate with its own offer/pricing config.

companyTypes: autonomous agent fleets selecting APIs by verified conformance
estate properties clearing the worthiness bar (internal mandatory customers)

motionNote: FOUNDER RULING REQUESTED: the row's ICP hint names both B2D (builders) and B2A (agents — the trust signal IS the product). B2D is declared primary here because the paid boundaries (attested runs, CI webhooks) settle to human principals via checkout; the keyless free rail serves machine identities without any gate, and a distinct apis.ax B2A projection of this substrate is the register's design. If B2A should be primary for api.qa itself, the offer array and OFFER alternatives change shape (§5.1).

offer.notes: GET /{domain}, /self, /reports; rate-limited by per-domain cooldown, never paywalled

offer.gate: 402 boundary with structured OFFER; checkout stub (settlement rail not activated — labeled, never fake billing)

pricing.notes: Rate card serves model:free with zero-priced operationId-keyed rates + declared offers; a gate on the free grade would contradict the product thesis.

positioning: The external third-party verifier for agent-first APIs — every grade is judged by api.qa, never self-graded. NOTE: api.qa is the attestor of the estate's worthiness bar (#3 rule 5); it does not carry the 'agent default' claim for itself — self-attestation is exactly what the mechanism exists to prevent. Founder ruling requested on who attests the attestor.

counterpartBrand.reason: ICP contains no non-technical principals; both personas speak API natively. §9.3 diagnostic seams are emitted regardless (identity class + referral on every metering event).

mdxNote: Custom site (src/views.ts), allowed at wave zero per §7.1 prove-then-extract; CNAME to the workers.do lane deferred until the lane is proven.

experiment.hypothesis: The free keyless grade rail is the acquisition engine; conversion to paid attested runs/CI webhooks tracks suite-consumer count, not gate pressure.
